theater: 君士坦丁堡城牆與博斯普魯斯海峽

battle.name: 君士坦丁堡之圍 (717年—718年)
battle.theater: 君士坦丁堡城牆與博斯普魯斯海峽
battle.brief: 伍麥葉王朝在717年盛夏以海陸大軍合圍君士坦丁堡，力圖在三次攻勢之後再下一城。皇帝利奧三世靠狄奧多西城牆、封住金角灣的鐵鏈，以及羅馬巨盾傳統結成的盾牆頂住十三個月圍城；718年八月阿拉伯海軍在博斯普魯斯覆滅，陸軍因飢疫與保加爾、拜占庭的夾擊而崩潰，圍城最終以阿拉伯軍收兵退走告終。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 這場圍城是伍麥葉王朝與拜占庭帝國在717至718年之間的正面決戰，交戰地點正是拜占庭首都君士坦丁堡本身。阿拉伯一方由哈里發蘇萊曼·伊本·阿卜杜勒·馬利克發動，他坐鎮大馬士革，以兄弟馬斯拉馬·伊本·阿卜杜勒·馬利克為全軍總指揮，統率以敘利亞人與傑濟拉人為主力的「敘利亞人」軍；其下有在奇里乞亞沿岸活動的艦隊統帥烏馬爾·伊本·胡拜拉、先鋒將領蘇萊曼·伊本·穆阿德，以及718年春率陸路援軍西進的馬爾達珊。哈里發蘇萊曼在717年9月病逝，之後由烏馬爾二世接位，圍城解除時在位的正是烏馬爾二世。拜占庭一方是皇帝利奧三世與其子君士坦丁五世坐鎮的帝國：首都守軍由駐紮城內的禁軍（塔格瑪塔）、首都附近的軍區步兵、艦隊水兵，以及城牆上操作投射機與噴火器材的人手組成；此外還有希臘火的水手、帝國商船隊、以及色雷斯與歐普西克軍區抽調的補充兵力。戰局外還有兩股第三方力量：其一是與利奧三世訂有條約的保加爾人，其可汗特爾維爾在圍城後期不斷襲擊阿拉伯營壘；其二是拜占庭在亞美尼亞、敘利亞與小亞細亞各處殘存的守軍與游擊部隊。兩軍規模在史料中差異極大，阿拉伯方面的編年史形容大軍「不可數」，拜占庭方面的守軍人數則完全無從考證，現代史家估計不超過一萬五千人。
countriesEn: This siege was the direct confrontation between the Umayyad Caliphate and the Byzantine Empire in 717 to 718, fought in the Byzantine capital itself, Constantinople. The Arab side was launched by Caliph Sulayman ibn Abd al-Malik, who remained in Damascus, and he entrusted overall command to his brother Maslama ibn Abd al-Malik, who led a host drawn mainly from the Syrians and the Jazirans of the elite ahl al-Sham. Under him served Umar ibn Hubayra, who commanded a fleet operating along the Cilician coast, the vanguard leader Sulayman ibn Mu'ad, and Mardasan, who led a land reinforcement column west in the spring of 718. Caliph Sulayman died of illness in September 717, after which Umar II succeeded him, and it was Umar II who was on the throne when the siege was lifted. The Byzantine side was the empire of Emperor Leo III and his son Constantine V. The garrison of the capital consisted of the tagmata stationed inside the city, infantry from the themes quartered near the capital, the crews of the navy, and the men operating artillery and fire-throwing devices on the walls; Greek fire crews, the empire's merchant shipping, and reinforcement drafts from the Thracesian and Opsician themes all took direct part in the defence. Two third-party forces stood outside the main contest: the Bulgars, whose ruler Tervel had concluded a treaty with Leo III and who harried the Arab camp throughout the later stages of the siege; and the surviving Byzantine garrisons and partisan bands in Armenia, Syria, and Asia Minor. The two armies differ enormously in the sources: the Arab chroniclers call the host innumerable, while the Byzantine numbers are simply unknown, and modern historians estimate the defenders at no more than fifteen thousand men.
people: 利奧三世（伊索里亞人）是這場圍城真正的贏家。他原本只是安納托利亞軍區的將軍，716年靠阿拉伯軍的威脅與真真假假的談判，騙過馬斯拉馬，又在阿莫里翁設下以八百人守城的巧計，隨後在比西尼亞與安納托利亞軍區支持下稱帝，717年3月25日進入首都；他廢黜的狄奧西俄斯三世退位為修士，其子一同隱修，阿拉伯人原本指望利用的傀儡局面就此破滅。馬斯拉馬是包圍圈的實際策劃者，他下令在赫勒斯海峽的阿比多斯渡海，於城西北築起兩道石牆、把營地夾在中間，率海軍進入博斯普魯斯企圖完成海上封鎖。717年9月1日阿拉伯艦隊抵達赫卜多蒙，9月2日其後衛二十艘重艦與二千名海兵在博斯普魯斯遇逆風漂向城牆，被拜占庭分艦隊以希臘火焚毀；當夜利奧三世下令在金角灣拉起封鎖鐵鏈。718年春，埃及與北非的援軍艦隊一到即因船員倒戈而崩潰，馬爾達珊的陸路援軍在尼科米亞以南的索豐丘陵遭伏擊全滅。圍城解除後，君士坦丁五世以安納托利亞軍區為基地，於740年的阿克羅伊農戰役給予阿拉伯人更重的打擊；亞美尼亞出身的貴族阿爾塔巴斯多斯在圍城期間被晉升為庫羅帕拉特並迎娶利奧三世之女安娜，742年一度篡位。編年史家西奧菲anes記錄了整場圍城，但他自任海戰統帥的說法與其自身記載互相矛盾，學界多有保留；傳說中的阿拉伯英雄阿卜杜拉·巴塔爾則在後來的伊斯蘭史詩中被塑造成戰勝者。
peopleEn: Leo III the Isaurian was the true winner of the siege. He had begun as nothing more than a general of the Anatolic theme; in 716 he exploited the threat of the Arab army and a mixture of truth and deception to mislead Maslama, and at Amorium he staged the trick of placing eight hundred men in a fortress that the Arabs had already taken, and with the backing of the Bithynian and Anatolic themes he was acclaimed emperor, entering the capital on 25 March 717. Theodosius III, whom he deposed, retired to a monastery as a monk together with his son, and the puppet arrangement the Arabs had counted on collapsed. Maslama was the real planner of the encirclement: he ordered his host across the Hellespont at Abydos, built two stone walls northwest of the city with the camp between them, and led the fleet into the Bosporus in order to complete the blockade by sea. On 1 September 717 the Arab fleet reached the Hebdomon, and on 2 September its rear guard of twenty heavy ships with two thousand marines drifted towards the city walls in the Bosporus when the wind fell and reversed, and was burnt up by a Byzantine squadron using Greek fire; that same night Leo III had the chain drawn across the entrance to the Golden Horn. In the spring of 718 the relief fleets from Egypt and Africa collapsed as soon as they arrived because their crews defected, and the land column of Mardasan was annihilated in an ambush in the hills of Sophon south of Nicomedia. After the siege was lifted, Constantine V, based on the Anatolic theme, inflicted a far heavier blow on the Arabs at the Battle of Akroinon in 740. Theophanes the Confessor recorded the whole siege, but his claim to have commanded the naval action clashes with his own narrative and is much disputed by scholars. The legendary Arab hero Abdallah al-Battal was turned by later Islamic epic into a conqueror.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬方陣盾（scutum）在717年早已不是現役裝備，它在這場圍城裡的位置，要到拜占庭重步兵的盾牆上才找得到。scutum 源於共和時期的戰鬥，以凸面橢圓形大牌為主，靠盾緣互相咬合成連續的盾面；到帝國後期它縮小並改為橢圓形，加上中央盾紐與彩繪紋章，五世紀的《巴貝里尼象牙雕》就刻出一名持這種盾的羅馬士兵。到了拜占庭時代，這種盾的直接後裔是重裝步兵所持的大橢圓盾，繪有獅鷲或怪獸徽記，與《約書亞卷》裏的形象一脈相承；利奧六世《戰術論》更記載弓兵除大盾外還在腰際懸掛小圓盾（skouton），腰佩短刀（paramerion），甲胄騎士則用小圓盾、長矛與雙曲弓。圍城裏真正被寫進戰報的裝備是攻城與守城器械：城牆上配置了配重式投石機（mangana）與手拉式弩炮（cheiroballistra），還有能裝上船的巨型弩機（helepolis）；希臘火以銅管虹吸裝置固定在船首與城牆的投射位，成為對付密集艦隊的決定性武器；阿拉伯一方則儲存了大量石腦油作燃燒劑，阿拉伯史料提到的投石機（tribolum）與攻城撞槌，都是用來對付狄奧多西城牆那套三層防禦體系——最外是深濠，其後是低牆與外壕，再後是高達二十米左右的主牆與雉堞，陸牆全線約五點五公里。封住金角灣入口的是一條從城內拉到加拉塔的粗鐵鏈；海峽爭奪中阿拉伯人曾打算夜間駛向海牆、用船槳搭牆強攻，說明雙方都把登船攻城當作現成手段。阿拉伯的補給隊伍極為龐大：光運糧隊就有約一萬二千人、六千頭駱駝與六千頭驢，軍中還帶了小麥種子，準備圍城次年就地播種。拜占庭的糧食全靠海運，海上封鎖未成之後漁民重新出海，商船不斷把糧食運進金角灣。
kitsEn: The Roman scutum on the card had long since left active service by 717, and the place it occupies in this siege can only be found in the shield wall of the Byzantine heavy infantry. The scutum came out of the wars of the Roman Republic as a large convex oval shield, its defensive value resting on shield edges biting into one another to form a continuous face; by the Imperial period it had shrunk into an oval form, gained a central boss and painted blazons, and the Barberini ivory of the fifth century shows a Roman soldier carrying exactly such a shield. In Byzantine times the direct descendant of that shield was the large oval shield of the heavy infantry, painted with a sphinx or a beast blazon and continuous with the figures on the sixth-century Joshua Roll. Leo VI's Tactica records that the psilos carried the large shield plus a small round shield (skouton) hung at the waist and a short sword (paramerion) at the belt, while the kataphract used a small round shield, a long kontos and a composite bow. The equipment actually named in the reports of the siege were the siege and defence machines: counterweight mangana and the hand-drawn cheiroballistra stood on the walls, together with huge bolt-shooting helepoloi that could be mounted in ships. Greek fire, fixed in bronze siphons on ship prows and on wall firing positions, became the decisive weapon against massed fleets. The Arabs had stockpiled large quantities of naphtha as incendiaries, and the stone-throwing machine (tribolum) and battering rams in the Arabic sources were meant for the three-line Theodosian defence system: a deep ditch first, then a low wall and outer rampart, then the main curtain about twenty metres high with its battlements, the land circuit running some five and a half kilometres in all. Closing the mouth of the Golden Horn was a heavy chain drawn from the city to Galata. During the struggle in the strait the Arabs planned to bring their ships at night against the sea wall and use the ships' steering paddles to climb it, which shows that both sides treated boarding the walls as a ready-made expedient. The Arab supply column was enormous: some twelve thousand men, six thousand camels and six thousand donkeys are given for the baggage train alone, and the army brought wheat seed to sow in the year after the siege should succeed. Byzantium's grain came entirely by sea, and once the blockade had failed the fishermen went back to work and merchant ships carried supplies into the Golden Horn without let-up.
tactics: 阿拉伯方面的戰術大綱是「海陸合圍、斷糧逼降」：陸軍在城西北築兩道石牆把營地夾在中間，隔絕色雷斯原野的供應與援軍通道；海軍分隊停泊博斯普魯斯兩岸，一支監視南入口，一支切斷首都通往黑海的道路，再企圖以突襲船隊與封鎖港門切斷海上糧道。717年9月1日艦隊進峽後原本打算夜間駛向海牆，用船槳搭牆強攻，失敗後退守索斯特尼翁。阿拉伯軍真正的破綻在補給：遠征軍的糧秣靠敘利亞基地與隨軍畜群供給，色雷斯原野已被大軍掃空，冬季一旦斷糧就無從補充。拜占庭的守城戰術則以「拖、離、反」為主：以狄奧多西城牆的深壕與高牆承受遠程器械，卻不與敵軍接戰；用艦隊在博斯普魯斯主動出擊，以希臘火燒毀貼近城牆的敵艦；用封鎖鐵鏈把海門關起來；再用小股騎兵與步兵在色雷斯丘陵打游擊，於718年春伏擊馬爾達珊的援軍縱隊；同時拉攏保加爾人，讓特爾維爾的騎兵從背後襲擊阿拉伯營壘，逼其退走。守軍在城牆上的部署沿用帝國晚期的接力防守：皇宮與主城樓一段由禁軍把守，缺口與角樓由軍區步兵填補，後方由城市民兵與工兵支援。城牆上仍用羅馬式大盾互相咬合，排成連續的盾面以遮蔽投射物，這是 scutum 留下的最耐用的遺產——不靠盾厚，而靠盾緣相接。整場圍城裡決定勝負的並非一次正面會戰，而是海峽裡一場火海與三個月的嚴冬。
tacticsEn: The Arab plan of battle was encirclement by sea and land, cutting off supplies and forcing surrender. The army raised two stone walls northwest of the city with the camp between them, sealing off the Thracian countryside as a source of food and as a road for reinforcements. The fleet was stationed in sections along both shores of the Bosporus, one covering the southern entrance, another cutting the capital's road to the Black Sea, with attempts to sever the sea supply line by surprise squadrons and by closing the harbour mouths. Having entered the strait on 1 September 717, the fleet had intended to sail at night against the sea wall and climb it with the steering paddles; after that failed it withdrew to the safe harbour of Sosthenion. The real weakness of the Arab army lay in supply. Its rations came from the Syrian base and from the herds it carried with it, the Thracian countryside had been stripped bare by the host's advance, and once winter cut the road there was no way to resupply. Byzantium's defence worked on the logic of delay, separation and riposte. The deep ditch and tall curtain of the Theodosian walls absorbed missiles while the garrison refused to be drawn into a general engagement. The fleet struck actively in the Bosporus and burned enemy ships that came hard against the walls with Greek fire. The chain closed the sea gate. Small bodies of cavalry and infantry harried the Thracian hills, and in the spring of 718 they ambushed and destroyed Mardasan's reinforcement column. At the same time the court bought off the Bulgars, and Tervel's horsemen struck the Arab camp from the rear, forcing the withdrawal. The manning of the walls followed the late imperial system of continuous relief: the tagmata held the palace and the main towers, the theme infantry filled the weaker stretches and the corner towers, and the urban militia and engineers supported from behind. On the wall the men still overlapped their Roman-style large shields into a continuous face against missiles, and that was the most durable legacy of the scutum: not thickness, but edge biting into edge. What decided the siege was not a pitched battle but a sea of fire in the strait and three months of severe winter.
data: 圍城自717年盛夏阿拉伯大軍抵達赫勒斯海峽北岸算起，到718年8月15日解圍，共十三個月。守軍人數無從考證，現代史家估計首都守軍不超過一萬五千人；阿拉伯方面的數字由「不可數」到極度誇張不等：敘利亞編年史《祖克寧編年史》稱其「無數」，米海爾·敘利亞人記作二十萬人、五千艘船，阿爾·馬蘇迪記作十二萬人，西奧菲anes記作一千八百艘船；圍城前一年阿拉伯人已在敘利亞集結，囤積數年糧秣與攻城器械。遠征軍的運糧隊被記作約一萬二千人、六千頭駱駝與六千頭驢；巴爾·赫卜勞斯另記三萬名志願者（mutawa）參戰。戰鬥數字方面：717年9月2日被希臘火焚毀的海軍後衛為二十艘重艦與二千名海兵；718年春抵達的援軍為埃及四百艘與北非三百六十艘，兩支艦隊的船員多為基督徒，一到即倒戈；陸路援軍馬爾達珊部在索豐丘陵被全殲。損失方面的分歧更大：倫巴德史家保羅執事稱阿拉伯人餓病死者三十萬，阿拉伯方面的說法是全役十五萬人陣亡；西奧菲anes記保加爾人一次襲擊即殺傷二萬二千名阿拉伯人。撤退同樣悽慘：拜占庭記稱抵達敘利亞的只剩下五艘船，其餘在馬爾馬拉海遇風暴失散，部分船隻被泰拉火山的火山灰引燃。城池方面，狄奧多西陸牆沿線約五點五公里，設三層防禦與深濠；719年拜占庭船隊反攻敘利亞沿岸，焚毀拉奧狄刻亞港，720至721年又襲擊埃及的提尼斯，說明圍城之後帝國的攻勢並未停頓。
dataEn: Counting from the arrival of the Arab host on the northern shore of the Hellespont in the high summer of 717 to the lifting of the siege on 15 August 718, the blockade lasted thirteen months. The number of defenders is unknown; modern historians put the garrison of the capital at no more than fifteen thousand men. The Arab figures run from the unquantifiable to the wildly inflated: the Syriac Zuqnin Chronicle calls the host innumerable, Michael the Syrian gives 200,000 men and 5,000 ships, al-Mas'udi gives 120,000, and Theophanes gives 1,800 ships. In the year before the siege the Arabs had already mustered in Syria and hoarded provisions and siege engines for several years. The baggage train of the expedition is given as some twelve thousand men, six thousand camels and six thousand donkeys, while Bar Hebraeus separately records 30,000 volunteers (mutawa) taking part. In the fighting itself: the naval rear guard burnt by Greek fire on 2 September 717 was twenty heavy ships with two thousand marines; the reliefs that arrived in the spring of 718 were four hundred ships from Egypt and three hundred and sixty from Africa, their crews mostly Christians who deserted on arrival; and the land column of Mardasan was annihilated in the hills of Sophon. The losses are even more divided: Paul the Deacon, the Lombard historian, puts the Arab dead of hunger and disease at 300,000, while the Arab sources claim 150,000 perished in the whole campaign; Theophanes records the Bulgars killing 22,000 of the Arabs in a single stroke. The retreat was equally disastrous. Byzantine sources say only five ships reached Syria, the rest scattered in a storm in the Sea of Marmara, some of them set alight by the ash of the volcano of Thera. As for the defences, the Theodosian land circuit runs about five and a half kilometres with a triple line and a deep ditch. In 719 the Byzantine fleet raided the Syrian coast and burned the port of Laodicea, and in 720 or 721 it struck at Tinnis in Egypt, which shows that the imperial offensive did not stop after the siege.
cause: 哈里發蘇萊曼決心拿下君士坦丁堡，一半是地緣戰略，一半是家族與宗教的動機。敘利亞與阿拉伯史料說，他聽信「將有一位與先知同名的哈里發奪下這座城」的預言，而伍麥葉家族中只有他帶著先知蘇萊曼（所羅門）之名；敘利亞編年史更記他發誓「在耗盡阿拉伯的土地之前，或奪下這座城之前，不會停止與君士坦丁堡交戰」。第一次圍城（674至678年）雖以失敗告終，卻證明了這座城有可攻之機，此後二十年阿拉伯人逐步奪取安條尼亞、亞美尼亞與小亞細亞邊境，到717年已把拜占庭的邊防體系逼到崩潰。蘇萊曼把計畫交給兄弟馬斯拉馬統籌，準備在安納托利亞得手後直取色雷斯；伍麥葉人的如意算盤，是趁拜占庭皇位空懸、此前七年間幾度政變留下的內鬥，一次解決掉整個帝國。變數正是利奧三世：他用假意效忠與拖延，讓阿拉伯人先去攻阿莫里翁，等自己羽翼豐滿再公開反轉；及至717年3月入主首都，阿拉伯人失去了傀儡皇帝這條捷徑。另一層原因是拜占庭的守備本身：阿納斯塔修斯二世已事先修補城牆、配備投射機、儲備糧秣，並疏散無法囤積三年糧食的居民，狄奧多西城牆與海峽要塞仍然完好，而與保加爾可汗特爾維爾的條約也為帝國爭來一個背後的騎兵盟友。
causeEn: Caliph Sulayman's determination to take Constantinople was half geopolitical and half a matter of family and religion. The Syriac and Arabic sources say that he believed a prophecy that a caliph bearing the name of a prophet would capture the city, and that in the Umayyad house only he carried the name of the prophet Sulayman (Solomon). The Syriac chronicle goes further and has him swear that he would not stop fighting Constantinople before he had exhausted the lands of the Arabs or taken the city. The first siege of 674 to 678 had failed, yet it had proved the city could be assayed, and over the following twenty years the Arabs had taken the frontiers of Armenia, Anatolia and Asia Minor step by step, so that by 717 the Byzantine frontier system was close to collapse. Sulayman gave the operation to his brother Maslama to plan, intending to strike through Thrace once Asia Minor had been secured. The Umayyad calculation was that with the Byzantine throne in flux and the civil strife of the previous seven years still unresolved, one campaign might finish the empire off. The variable was Leo III. He played the part of a willing vassal, used delay to send the Arabs off to Amorium, and turned openly only once his own position was secure; by entering the capital in March 717 he robbed the Arabs of the short cut through a puppet emperor. A second cause lay in Byzantium's own readiness. Anastasius II had already repaired the walls, mounted artillery, stockpiled provisions and evacuated those inhabitants who could not hoard three years of food; the Theodosian walls and the fortifications of the strait were still intact, and the treaty with the Bulgar khan Tervel gave the empire a cavalry ally at its back.
impact: 這場圍城的失敗改變了兩個帝國的戰爭形態。阿拉伯方面，伍麥葉王朝放棄了攻取君士坦丁堡的目標，邊界在陶魯斯與安陶魯斯山脈一線穩定下來，此後兩百年的邊境衝突退化成劫掠與反劫掠，不再以滅國為目標；哈里發烏馬爾二世甚至動念放棄西班牙與河中地區的新征服地，雖然謀臣勸阻，阿拉伯軍仍從小亞細亞與奇里乞亞的前線堡壘大撤退，奇里乞亞只剩下莫普斯提亞一處據點。海上更慘：伍麥葉的東方艦隊自此一蹶不振，直到752年之後連北非艦隊的襲擾也停止；直到782年哈倫·拉希德兵臨克里斯波利斯，才是此後數百年間唯一一次阿拉伯軍再望見君士坦丁堡城牆。拜占庭方面，帝國得以延續，首都從此成為阻擋伊斯蘭勢力西進的堡壘直到十五世紀；利奧三世趁勢重整軍制，把軍區兵（themata）改稱禁軍（tagmata）並把精銳調入首都，財政改革也隨之展開；719年拜占庭艦隊反攻敘利亞海岸，約720至721年更深入埃及的提尼斯，722年前後重新控制西西里島。政治象徵上，拜占庭人把718年稱為「普世性的日期」，把它與馬拉松並列；阿拉伯方面的史詩則把敗仗改寫成勝利，說馬斯拉馬騎馬入城、接受利奧的致敬與納貢，阿卜杜拉·巴塔爾從此成為阿拉伯與土耳其詩歌中的常勝英雄。718年的圍城之後，末日論在伊斯蘭與拜占庭兩邊都生長出來：城之陷落被視為末世來臨的徵兆。
impactEn: The failure of the siege changed the shape of war for both empires. On the Arab side the Umayyad state abandoned any aim of taking Constantinople outright. The frontier settled along the line of the Taurus and Antitaurus mountains, and the next two centuries of conflict degenerated into raiding and counter-raiding rather than a war of conquest. Caliph Umar II was even recorded as contemplating the abandonment of the recent conquests in Spain and Transoxiana; though his advisers dissuaded him from such drastic steps, the Arab garrisons were withdrawn from the forward positions they had held in Asia Minor and Cilicia, and in Cilicia only Mopsuestia remained in Arab hands. At sea the blow was worse: the eastern fleets of the Caliphate declined for a century, and not even the raids of the Ifriqiyan fleets survived beyond 752. It was 782, when Harun al-Rashid reached Chrysopolis, before another Arab army saw the walls of Constantinople again. For Byzantium the capital survived, and from that moment it stood as the bulwark halting the westward advance of Islamic power until the fifteenth century. Leo III used the occasion to reorganise the army, renaming the themata as tagmata and drawing the best troops into the capital, and fiscal reform followed. In 719 the Byzantine fleet raided the Syrian coast, and in about 720 or 721 it struck deep into Egypt at Tinnis, while control of Sicily was restored around 722. In terms of political symbolism the Byzantines called 718 an ecumenical date and set it beside Marathon, while the Arabic epic reversed the defeat into a triumph, telling how Maslama entered the city on horseback and was received by Leo with homage and tribute, and how Abdallah al-Battal became the perennial conqueror of Arab and Turkish song. After 718 eschatology grew on both sides, in Islam and in Byzantium: the fall of the city came to be read as a sign of the end of the age.
result: 718年8月15日，哈里發烏馬爾二世下令撤軍，阿拉伯大軍在圍城十三個月後離開君士坦丁堡；拜占庭人把這一天對應到聖母安息節，視為天佑的結果。撤退本身是一場災難：艦隊在馬爾馬拉海遇上風暴失散，部分船隻被泰拉火山的火山灰引燃，拜占庭史家說最後只有五艘船回到敘利亞；陸軍在色雷斯平原回師時仍受飢疫與追擊拖累。阿拉伯方面的說法是全役折損十五萬人，倫巴德史家甚至記到三十萬餓病死者；這些數字都屬誇張，但足以說明這場遠征對伍麥葉王朝財政與人力打擊之大，連帶觸發對敘利亞與埃及的加稅與地方反叛。拜占庭雖守住京城，卻沒有趁勢反攻得力，720年之後阿拉伯人的襲擊重新開始，只是目標已從征服改為掠奪，二十年後拜占庭在740年的阿克羅伊農戰役才真正把邊防推回小亞細亞腹地。對利奧三世個人而言，這一戰鞏固了他在皇位上的地位，他以皇帝的全稱自居並重整軍制；對整個歐洲而言，718年與同年的都爾戰役同被視為兩道把穆斯林西進擋在基督教世界門外的關卡。
resultEn: On 15 August 718 Caliph Umar II ordered the retreat, and the Arab host left Constantinople after thirteen months of siege. The Byzantines matched the day to the Dormition of the Mother of God and took it as a sign of divine favour. The withdrawal itself was a disaster: the fleet scattered in a storm in the Sea of Marmara, some ships set alight by the ash of the volcano of Thera, and the Byzantine chronicler says that in the end only five vessels reached Syria. The land army dragged back across the Thracian plain still weighed down by hunger, disease and pursuit. The Arab figure for the whole campaign is 150,000 dead, and the Lombard historian goes as high as 300,000 dead of hunger and sickness. These numbers are plainly inflated, yet they do convey how severely the expedition drained the manpower and finances of the Umayyad state, and heavier taxation in Syria and Egypt with local unrest followed. Byzantium saved the capital but failed to press its advantage, and Arab attacks resumed from 720, though their aim had shifted from conquest to plunder; only at the Battle of Akroinon in 740 did Byzantium push the frontier back into the interior of Asia Minor. For Leo III personally the siege confirmed his position on the throne, and he ruled under the full imperial title after reorganising the army. For Europe as a whole, 718 and the battle of Tours in the same year came to be seen as the two barriers that held the Muslim advance outside the gates of the Christian world.
